risk_note: Taobao user authorization server side (BR-ID-17, BR-ATTR-05), successor of B1-04zzzzn (D10-3175; that task voided after its Codex call breaker 10/10). Commits carried over from B1-04zzzzn head 820c6529c via rebase (per-file patch-id identical; only the taobao-adapter.ts file header comment merged with B1-04zzzzo #732, D10-3178). Filing attempts are recorded before publisher.info.save in their own committed transaction (new table app.union_filing_attempts, migration 0155; couli_app SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE(outcome, finished_at); tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts funds/attribution list +1 line). A duplicate filing's id (read back, or carried in a save answer that has the duplicate flag) is accepted only against an existing binding of the same app, user, platform and union account; otherwise 50001, nothing written, warned duplicate_after_unknown_attempt (with the earlier unknown attempt's id) or duplicate_unverified; failed read-backs (immediate error or governance time limit) are judged the same; unknown attempts are never credentials (D10-2872 / D10-2972 / D10-3129 / D10-3196). Gateway system errors (isp.* except isp.call-limited) on save / get are dependency failures, never credential_invalid; the attempt stays unknown. Readiness (user OAuth app, inviter code, inviter account = selected account) is checked before writing and before consuming a state, shared by issuance (link open, shop entry with the selected account) and submission. Known and recorded out of scope: FU-TAOBAO-OAUTH-APP-ROTATION, FU-FILING-ATTEMPT-CLOCK-SKEW (earlier = started_at from the injected Clock, D10-2851 / D10-3200), FU-UNION-BINDING-REPLAY-AFTER-UNSTORED-50001 (D10-3203), FU-FILING-ATTEMPT-PATROL, FU-TB-05-DUP-LOOKUP, attempt state FK not constrained to app/user. Tokens and Taobao identity are not stored or logged. No money arithmetic.
